title: deploy-factory's shipped paths miss harness/embed, the new embed root
description:
Tick 0ek added harness/embed/local-main.bundle.mjs as a go:embed root of the root package, so it ships inside the ticfac binaries the deploy cross-compiles into the image. deploy-factory.yml's `paths` array enumerates harness/ subpaths individually (harness/src, harness/package.json, harness/pnpm-lock.yaml, harness/pnpm-workspace.yaml, harness/tsconfig.json) and does not include harness/embed, so a commit on main whose only shipped change is a regenerated bundle — a rebuild under a newer esbuild, a change to harness/scripts/build-local-bundle.mjs's define/target, a hand-fix — is decided 'nothing that ships changed' and skipped, leaving the factory's orchestrator containers running the previous bundle. The staleness gate cannot catch it either: it hashes harness/src, not the bundle, so a bundle-only change passes make gate. The workflow's own comment calls the list 'deliberately broad: a needless deploy costs ten minutes, a missed one is a factory running old code'. One path entry fixes it.
evidence: .github/workflows/deploy-factory.yml:281-290 (the paths array; its harness entries are :284-285); `git diff --name-only origin/main HEAD -- <those paths> | grep harness` prints harness/src/local/main.ts but not harness/embed/local-main.bundle.mjs

ticfac run run_03aa9c8a71574ab3891b47df3dbd5ec9 filed this backlog tick from the finding 26c06b05e51ea0ea61f8684bcd16f4660aeb8826b1dbd0b4b24a7e31be6a4c50 (reported by run-run_03aa9c8a71574ab3891b47df3dbd5ec9/tick-two/attempt-8) rather than absorb it into the running epic: it is not absorbed: only a finding the final reviewer names blocking, or a high-severity one whose reporter names the done item it breaks while the work is under way, enters the running epic. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/run_03aa9c8a71574ab3891b47df3dbd5ec9/absorptions/26c06b05e51ea0ea61f8684bcd16f4660aeb8826b1dbd0b4b24a7e31be6a4c50.json on the run branch.
